TREATMENT

Fire & Ice Facials in Ghaziabad & Noida

Instant Glow For Every Special Occasion

Overview

Fire & Ice Facial is a professional skin rejuvenation treatment designed to resurface, refresh, and revitalize the skin.

Often referred to as the “Red Carpet Facial,” it combines intensive exfoliation with soothing hydration to improve skin texture, radiance, and overall appearance. The treatment helps reduce dullness, refine pores, and promote a smoother, brighter complexion while providing an instantly refreshed look with minimal downtime.

Key benefits

  • Instantly enhances skin radiance
  • Improves texture and smoothness
  • Helps reduce dullness and fatigue
  • Refines the appearance of pores
  • Supports healthier-looking skin
  • Ideal before important events
  • Minimal downtime with visible results

Who should opt

  • Individuals with dull or tired skin
  • People seeking an instant facial glow
  • Those preparing for weddings or events
  • Individuals with uneven skin texture
  • People wanting skin rejuvenation
  • Anyone looking for a refreshed appearance
